name: Dried Moringa Leaves (100g)
description: Sun-dried Moringa oleifera leaves from local Mbare growers. Rich in vitamins A, C, and E. Use in teas, smoothies, or as a food supplement.

name: Zumbani Tea (50g)
description: Lippia javanica loose-leaf tea, naturally dried. Traditionally brewed for colds, flu, and chest complaints. Steep 2-3 leaves in boiling water for 5 minutes.

name: Neem Capsules (60ct)
description: Azadirachta indica capsules for skin health and immune support. Take 1-2 capsules daily with water. Not recommended during pregnancy.

name: Ginger & Turmeric Mix (200g)
description: Fresh-ground ginger and turmeric blend from organic Bulawayo farms. Anti-inflammatory properties. Mix 1 teaspoon into warm water or tea daily.

name: Aloe Vera Gel (250ml)
description: Pure aloe vera gel for skin soothing, wound healing, and sunburn relief. Harvested from Chitungwiza-grown plants. Apply topically as needed.

name: African Wormwood Bundle (50g)
description: Artemisia afra dried herb bundle, the most widely used traditional remedy in southern Africa. Brew as tea for coughs, colds, and respiratory infections.

name: Wild Garlic Tincture (30ml)
description: Allium sativum tincture from Eastern Highlands wild garlic. Take 5-10 drops in water daily for immune and cardiovascular support.

name: Fever Tree Bark Powder (100g)
description: Cinchona bark powder, traditional remedy for fevers and malaria symptoms. Mix 1/2 teaspoon in warm water. Consult a healer before use.

name: Lion's Tail Tea (40g)
description: Leonotis leonurus loose-leaf tea. Calming herb traditionally used for anxiety, insomnia, and tension. Steep 1 tablespoon in boiling water for 10 minutes.

name: Baobab Powder (150g)
description: Ground baobab fruit pulp, extremely high in vitamin C and fibre. Add to porridge, smoothies, or juice. Sourced from mature baobab trees in Masvingo.
